title: Why Linear Models Can Still Work in a Complex and Changing World
abstract: arXiv:2610.13404v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Linear models can predict well in complex domains even when underlying mechanisms are nonlinear. We argue that this can occur because the complexity of the world exceeds the complexity that can be learned reliably from finite, partially observed data. Flexible models can exploit curvature, thresholds, and interactions that fit one hospital, period, population, policy setting, or measurement process but fail elsewhere. When this instability lies mainly in the nonlinear component, omitting it can give linear models lower prediction error in a new environment. We connect this claim to work on simple linear rules, bias and variance, regularization, best linear prediction, measurement error, distribution shift, invariance, Rashomon sets, and underspecification. translated_title: 为什么线性模型在复杂多变的世界中仍然有效
translated_abstract: 即使底层机制是非线性的，线性模型在复杂领域中也能做出良好的预测。我们认为，这是因为世界的复杂性超过了从有限的、部分观测的数据中能够可靠学习的复杂性。灵活的模型可以利用曲率、阈值和交互效应，这些特征可能恰好适用于某个医院、某个时期、某个人群、某种政策环境或某种测量过程，但在其他环境中却会失效。当这种不稳定性主要存在于非线性成分中时，忽略该成分反而能让线性模型在新环境中获得更低的预测误差。我们将这一论点与关于简单线性规则、偏差与方差、正则化、最佳线性预测、测量误差、分布偏移、不变性、Rashomon集合以及欠规范性的研究联系起来。命题1给出了一个简单的平方误差情形：在训练环境中学习的非线性规则因其迁移能力太弱，反而提高了目标环境中的误差；有限样本估计……
tldr: 该论文论证了当世界的复杂性超出有限、部分观测数据所能可靠学习的范围时，灵活的非线性模型会过度拟合特定环境的细节而难以迁移，因此省略不稳定非线性成分的线性模型在分布变化的新环境中反而能取得更低的预测误差。
en_tdlr: When the world's complexity exceeds what can be reliably learned from finite, partially observed data, flexible nonlinear models overfit environment-specific details that fail to transfer, so linear models that omit the unstable nonlinear component can achieve lower prediction error under distribution shift.
